HomePage.title: PixelRing Reparatur
HomePage.description: PixelRing supports businesses with defective signage, LED elements and visual infrastructure at commercial locations. Start with a short note or photo — we review the details and coordinate the next step.
HomePage.trust_badge: One contact. One structured service process. Clear coordination.

Trust.description: Not a portal, not a random technician, and not scattered coordination. PixelRing accepts the request, helps understand the problem, organizes the work, and keeps the site in service support.
Trust.cta_subtext: Start with a short note or photo.

stats.label: DIRECT SERVICE
stats.description: PixelRing accepts the request as one service company: from first contact to work coordination and further support. The customer does not search for contractors, compare random contacts, or explain the task again to every participant.
stats.highlight: One request — one point of responsibility.

stats.label: BUDGET
stats.value: AI lowers the cost of getting started
stats.description: The AI assistant helps process the initial request: it gathers photos, a description, and basic data before a specialist joins.
stats.highlight: We save on initial information handling, not on quality.

stats.label: CLARITY
stats.description: No uncertainty. The customer sees the request progress in the PixelRing account: from request acceptance to coordination, work execution, and service support.

stats.label: RESPONSIBILITY
stats.description: We coordinate the request from first contact through work execution and remain the central contact point for the site.
stats.highlight: You do not need to connect every participant manually.

stats.label: WARRANTY AND SERVICE
stats.description: All completed work is covered by warranty conditions, and the site receives a service status in the PixelRing system.
stats.highlight: PixelRing remains the business support point.

Intake.title: Choose your way
Intake.description: Start your request in the way that is most convenient for you. Our AI helps with fast capture.

steps.title: Start service
steps.description: Briefly describe the issue or send a photo. The AI assistant helps assess the situation and prepare an initial review.
steps.highlight: You do not need to understand the technical details.

steps.title: Specialist review
steps.description: After the initial assessment, our specialist reviews the information, asks follow-up questions if needed, and defines the right next step.
steps.highlight: You quickly understand what should happen next.

steps.title: Agree on the solution
steps.description: Scope, cost, timing, access to the site, and the execution format are clarified. You know what will be done and under which conditions.
steps.highlight: No surprises and no unnecessary coordination.

steps.title: Work execution
steps.description: After agreement, the work is coordinated and carried out by specialists. PixelRing remains the central contact point for your request.
steps.highlight: One process. One point of responsibility.

steps.title: Warranty and service
steps.description: Completed work is covered by clear warranty conditions, and the request and site remain traceable in PixelRing's service history.
steps.highlight: PixelRing remains the central service point for your business.

Roadmap.subtitle: After sending
Roadmap.title: What happens after you send the request?
Roadmap.description: After the form, the request enters the PixelRing service process: we store the details, issue a PR number, review the case and name the next step.

steps.title: Request in the system
steps.description: PixelRing stores the task description, photos, site address and contact for follow-up.

steps.title: PR number
steps.description: You receive a request number. It keeps the status and conversation tied to this case.

steps.title: Request review
steps.description: A specialist checks the description, photos and site details: what happened, where is the sign, what details are missing?

steps.title: Next step
steps.description: PixelRing explains what is needed next: clarify details, prepare an assessment, align a proposal or organize a site visit.

items.question: How fast do you respond?
items.answer: After approval, we are usually on-site within 24 to 48 hours.

items.question: What is the warranty period?
items.answer: We provide a 6 to 12-month warranty on all labor and replacement parts.

items.question: Do you work with private clients?
items.answer: Yes, we serve both commercial businesses and private individuals with the same level of care.

items.question: What areas do you cover?
items.answer: We have a nationwide network of experts and can handle requests across the entire country.

StatusPage.title: Check your request status
StatusPage.intro: Request number alone is only the first lookup step. To protect customer data, the case stays private until you verify with the original phone or email, or the same device restores access automatically.
StatusPage.safe_hint_1: Request number alone is not enough.
StatusPage.safe_hint_2: Use the phone or email from the original request, or continue on the same device that already has access.
StatusPage.safe_hint_3: Private notes, names, and message history stay hidden until verification succeeds.
StatusPage.restore_hint: If this device already has an active signed session, the status card will restore without you typing anything.
StatusPage.access_restored: Access restored from the signed cookie on this device.
StatusPage.contact_verified: The phone or email matched successfully.
StatusPage.lookup_error: Unable to look up the request right now.
StatusPage.privacy_notice: Private notes, customer names, and message history are still hidden. This view only shows the public status.
StatusPage.form_description: Enter your public request number. Then verify with the phone or email that was used when the request was created.
StatusPage.cookie_restore_hint: If you already used this device to create the request, you can skip the fields and let the signed cookie restore access automatically.

Reviews.title: Typical Service Cases
Reviews.subtitle: Anonymized examples of signage problems PixelRing records, checks, and coordinates with specialists.

items.name: Flickering LED Sign
items.content: An LED sign flickers visibly and affects the storefront. PixelRing collects photos, location details, and the fault description, checks the sensible next step, and coordinates diagnosis or repair.

items.name: Damaged Exterior Lettering
items.content: Letters, films, or lightboxes are damaged by weather, renovation, or wear. PixelRing documents the condition, clarifies materials and mounting requirements, and prepares the right execution path.

items.name: Installation After Renovation
items.content: After a renovation or move, existing signage needs to be adapted, repositioned, or reinstalled. PixelRing brings the request, measurements, and photos together and plans the work with the responsible specialists.
